provider_organization: EDiSU Pavia (Ente per il Diritto allo Studio Universitario di Pavia)

financial_coverage.tuition_coverage: Winners are exempt from the University of Pavia all-inclusive contribution (fees); the EUR 140 regional tax is refunded within the grant

stipend.notes: Total value incl. one free meal a day. Cash part: in-town EUR 1,314-2,601; commuter EUR 2,470-3,991; off-site (living away, 10+ months' housing) EUR 5,028-7,419; off-site in an EDiSU college EUR 2,088-4,479 plus free room. Band depends on ISEE. +20% for women in STEM degrees (not combined with the 15% low-income increase). Halved for the first extra year after normal course length. First-year students get full value only if they reach Allegato B credits by 10 Aug 2027 (50% if by 30 Nov 2027).

additional_benefits: Free room for winners of an EDiSU college place

application_fee.notes: No fee to apply to EDiSU. Original foreign documents must be delivered or posted at the student's own cost.

eligibility_criteria.min_gpa: First-year bachelor's/single-cycle: secondary school final grade at least 70/100 (foreign grades converted by MIUR formula). First-year master's/PhD: only regular enrolment and no previous enrolment at the same level. Later years: credits in Allegato A by 10 Aug 2026.
language_proficiency: None required for the grant itself

country_specific_notes.note: Nigeria is not on the 'particularly poor countries' list (D.M. 176/2026), so Nigerian students must submit official 2025 family income, property and bank documents from Nigerian authorities, legalised by the Italian embassy (or apostilled) with Italian translation. Originals must reach EDiSU by the deadline. Affidavits and self-declarations are rejected. Declared foreign income can never count as less than EUR 10,179.85.

required_documents.name: Originals of all foreign documents
required_documents.detail: Uploaded as PDF AND delivered in original (by appointment or by post)

preparation_alerts: Income limits: ISEE UNI (or ISEE parificato) up to EUR 26,887.93 AND ISPE up to EUR 58,452.06
Original legalised and translated foreign documents must physically reach EDiSU in Pavia by 15 Sep 2026 15:00; photocopies are not accepted
Embassy legalisation and translation take weeks; start in spring
Higher off-site amount needs proof of paid housing for 10 months (or an EDiSU college place)
One online application covers all EDiSU benefits; the earliest deadline (e.g. college places) applies
